title: Confidence Is Not Evidence — Verifying What AI Tells You

responses.videoreflect: After watching the video, the cause of the hallucination for the AI scenario who invented a "2023 evaluation study" is not enough context were given and created a vague prompt. It could mislead the model with the input prompt has not given it enough context when asked.
responses.rule: A personal rule me when I stop and verify an AI's answer before using it is to make sure it's a structure data and not an unstructured data that only shows me paragraph and claims. We need to see columns and rows and ask from where they have gathered all this evidence to support the data.
responses.clue: One question I would ask to any confident-sounding AI answer to decide whether it's actually been checked is to ask it provide evidence or ask where it has collected the data and start checking the system.
